newsitem.title: CHINA: Sun Fook Kong changes name to Hing Kong.
newsitem.headline: Sun Fook Kong changes name to Hing Kong.

text.p: Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its shareholders had approved a name change to Hing Kong Holdings Ltd to reflect the change in control of the company.
The company's financial year-end date will also change to December 31 from March 31 to fall in line with that of new controlling shareholder China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd.
The changes were made after a general meeting on Tuesday. China Travel International has made a general offer for shares of the company after it bought 51.66 percent of the construction concern.
Trading in China Travel International shares was suspended on Wednesday at the company's request pending an announcement.
